messages.subject: Thailand and ASEAN executive search | Corporate affairs, ESG and country leadership
messages.body:
Dear Robert Walters Thailand Executive Search Team,

I am reaching out for senior Thailand, ASEAN and APAC searches where international operating experience, government relations and ESG leadership are central to the mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My 12+ year career spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current scope covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance, executive advisory and cross-functional delivery.

My strongest search fit sits across Corporate Affairs, External Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Country Representative, Country Director, Chief of Staff and related regional leadership. I bring direct experience from a large industrial operation, including energy-transition stakeholder work around solar and battery storage and carbon-data governance.

I am open to Thailand-based or regional expatriate mandates and have attached a Robert Walters-focused executive CV for your review. I would value consideration across your Bangkok and Eastern Seaboard client portfolio.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
